verses.en: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;
verses.pt: Mas o Espírito expressamente diz que em tempos posteriores alguns apostatarão da fé, dando ouvidos a espíritos enganadores, e a doutrinas de demônios,
verses.en_web: But the Spirit says expressly that in later times some will fall away from the faith, paying attention to seducing spirits and doctrines of demons,
verses.en_bbe: But the Spirit says clearly that in later times some will be turned away from the faith, giving their minds to spirits of deceit, and the teachings of evil spirits,

verses.en: Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;
verses.pt: pela hipocrisia de homens que falam mentiras e têm a sua própria consciência cauterizada,
verses.en_web: through the hypocrisy of men who speak lies, branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron;
verses.en_bbe: Through the false ways of men whose words are untrue, whose hearts are burned as with a heated iron;

verses.en: Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.
verses.pt: proibindo o casamento, e ordenando a abstinência de alimentos que Deus criou para serem recebidos com ações de graças pelos que são fiéis e que conhecem bem a verdade;
verses.en_web: forbidding marriage and commanding to abstain from foods which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.
verses.en_bbe: Who keep men from being married and from taking food which God made to be taken with praise by those who have faith and true knowledge.

verses.en: For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:
verses.pt: pois todas as coisas criadas por Deus são boas, e nada deve ser rejeitado se é recebido com ações de graças;
verses.en_web: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected, if it is received with thanksgiving.
verses.en_bbe: Because everything which God has made is good, and nothing is evil, if it is taken with praise:

verses.en: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.
verses.pt: porque pela palavra de Deus e pela oração são santificadas.
verses.en_web: For it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer.
verses.en_bbe: For it is made holy by the word of God and by prayer.

verses.en: If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.
verses.pt: Propondo estas coisas aos irmãos, serás bom ministro de Cristo Jesus, nutrido pelas palavras da fé e da boa doutrina que tens seguido;
verses.en_web: If you instruct the brothers of these things, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished in the words of the faith, and of the good doctrine which you have followed.
verses.en_bbe: If you keep these things before the minds of the brothers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, trained in the words of the faith and of the right teaching which has been your guide:

verses.en: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables, and exercise thyself rather unto godliness.
verses.pt: mas rejeita as fábulas profanas e de velhas. Exercita-te a ti mesmo na piedade.
verses.en_web: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables. Exercise yourself toward godliness.
verses.en_bbe: But have nothing to do with unclean and foolish stories. Give yourself training in religion:

verses.en: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.
verses.pt: Pois o exercício corporal para pouco aproveita, mas a piedade para tudo é proveitosa, visto que tem a promessa da vida presente e da que há de vir.
verses.en_web: For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now, and of that which is to come.
verses.en_bbe: For the training of the body is of profit for a little, but religion is of profit in every way, giving hope for the life which now is, and for that which is to come.

verses.en: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.
verses.pt: Fiel é esta palavra e digna de toda aceitação.
verses.en_web: This saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance.
verses.en_bbe: This is a true saying, in which all may put their faith.

verses.en: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.
verses.pt: Pois para isto é que trabalhamos e lutamos, porque temos posto a nossa esperança no Deus vivo, que é o Salvador de todos os homens, especialmente dos que crêem.
verses.en_web: For to this end we both labor and suffer reproach, because we have set our trust in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, especially of those who believe.
verses.en_bbe: And this is the purpose of all our work and our fighting, because our hope is in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, and specially of those who have faith.
Let these be your orders and your teaching.

verses.en: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
verses.pt: Ninguém despreze a tua mocidade, mas sê um exemplo para os fiéis na palavra, no procedimento, no amor, na fé, na pureza.
verses.en_web: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.
verses.en_bbe: Let no one make little of you because you are young, but be an example to the church in word, in behaviour, in love, in faith, in holy living.

verses.en: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.
verses.pt: até que eu vá, aplica-te à leitura, à exortação, e ao ensino.
verses.en_web: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.
verses.en_bbe: Till I come, give attention to the reading of the holy Writings, to comforting the saints, and to teaching.

verses.en: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.
verses.pt: Não negligencies o dom que há em ti, o qual te foi dado por profecia, com a imposição das mãos do presbítero.
verses.en_web: Don’t neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the elders.
verses.en_bbe: Make use of that grace in you, which was given to you by the word of the prophets, when the rulers of the church put their hands on you.

verses.en: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.
verses.pt: Ocupa-te destas coisas, dedica-te inteiramente a elas, para que o teu progresso seja manifesto a todos.
verses.en_web: Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.
verses.en_bbe: Have a care for these things; give yourself to them with all your heart, so that all may see how you go forward.

verses.en: Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.
verses.pt: Tem cuidado de ti mesmo e do teu ensino; persevera nestas coisas; porque, fazendo isto, te salvarás, tanto a ti mesmo como aos que te ouvem.
verses.en_web: Pay attention to yourself, and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.
verses.en_bbe: Give attention to yourself and your teaching. Go on in these things; for in doing so you will get salvation for yourself and for those who give hearing to you.
